description: Defines the TaskNode class extending YAHOO.widget.TextNode, implementing a checkbox with three states for task completion, including methods for managing check states, updating parent nodes, and rendering HTML.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TaskNode
classes.description: A node representing a task with a checkbox that can be in three states, supporting cascade updates and HTML rendering.

methods.name: taskNodeParentChange
methods.description: Handles parent node change events, creating a 'checkClick' event if not already present.

methods.name: setUpCheck
methods.description: Initializes the check state of the node based on the 'checked' parameter.

methods.name: getCheckElId
methods.description: Returns the DOM element ID for the checkbox.

methods.name: getCheckStyle
methods.description: Returns the CSS class name based on the check state.

methods.name: getCheckLink
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript link to trigger check click.

methods.name: checkClick
methods.description: Handles click event on the checkbox, toggling check state.

methods.name: onCheckClick
methods.description: Placeholder for custom behavior on check click.

methods.name: updateParent
methods.description: Updates parent node check state based on children.

methods.name: updateCheckHtml
methods.description: Updates the checkbox HTML element's class based on current state.

methods.name: setCheckState
methods.description: Sets the check state and updates the 'checked' boolean.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks the node and all children, updates parent if cascadeUp is true.

methods.name: uncheck
methods.description: Unchecks the node and all children, updates parent.

methods.name: getNodeHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML for the node, including checkbox, label, and styling.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the node.
